brief.title: Reconcile OBJ-2 / PROJ-88 / GH-101 with the 2026-07-12 SSO scope decision
brief.body:
Update OBJ-2 status from "on_track" to "at_risk / needs re-scope decision" — the 2026-07-12 leadership call (SLACK-501) narrowed scope to SAML-only, but the objective still reads full SSO+SCIM.
Reconcile PROJ-88 (still "High"/"In Progress" for full SCIM scope) and resolve PROJ-95 (the open scope-check task) against the SLACK-501 decision.
Triage GH-101: with SCIM group-claims now out of scope per SLACK-501, decide fix-vs-close, and assign an owner — it currently has none despite the "enterprise-blocker" label.
Flag strategy.md Pillar 2 wording for the next planning review; it still states "SCIM group provisioning" as required and was last reviewed 2026-06-01, before the 07-12 decision.
No action needed on GH-102, GH-103, PROJ-90 (dark mode / typo) — aligned with strategy.md's explicit non-goals, or on OBJ-1 / OBJ-3 / GH-104 — tracking on plan.

proposed_external_effects.comment: Rescoped to SAML-only per 2026-07-12 leadership decision (SLACK-501). See OBJ-2.
Flagging for triage: SCIM group-claims scope may be dropped per 2026-07-12 leadership decision. Needs an owner either way.
Marked at_risk pending re-scope per SLACK-501.
